exposure: high dependency unit/intensive care unit admission
outcome: Prevalence of partial and exclusive breastfeeding
cohort: Women who gave birth in one maternity unit in England (n = 1824)
finding: This study found no significant difference in breastfeeding outcomes between women who did or did not experience severe maternal morbidity, except for women with severe hypertensive disorder who were less likely to breastfeed.
mod_finding: Mode of birth was found to be related to breastfeeding outcomes.
